stories.title: Judge denies new trial for Karmelo Anthony in stabbing conviction
new_facts: Establishes core story: Texas judge denies Karmelo Anthony a new trial in Austin Metcalf murder case.
Adds jury verdict (June, Collin County), 35-year sentence, Frisco location 28 miles from Dallas.
Adds detail of a 2-day hearing with 'explosive allegations' and new defense team seeking retrial.
Ex-lawyers testified a dispute over an unwritten deal with prosecutors kept Anthony from testifying.
Notes the ruling came from a newly appointed judge.
stories.line: A Texas judge rejected a new-trial request from Karmelo Anthony, who was convicted in a stabbing death, after a hearing revealed disputes with his former lawyers.

stories.title: U.S. and Canada trade war escalates with tariffs, retaliation
new_facts: Carney called the tariffs a 'miscalculation' and said Canada walked away to protect its sovereignty
Retaliatory tariffs will target dairy, steel, appliances, farm equipment, electronics, pulp and paper
stories.line: U.S. imposes 50% tariffs on Canadian goods; Canada announces retaliatory tariffs beginning Sept. 8 after trade negotiations fail.

stories.title: Bird flu detected at Western Australian sea lion breeding ground
new_facts: First Australian mammal case: a long-nosed fur seal in South Australia tests positive for bird flu.
Suspected bird flu spreading to Australian sea lion breeding grounds, linked to mass bird deaths.
WA's black swan, an H5N1 indicator species, faces significant mortality risk as bird flu threat emerges
stories.line: Bird flu has reached a sea lion breeding ground in Western Australia, threatening a vulnerable marine mammal population.

stories.title: Kennedy avoids vaccine discussion while promoting broader health agenda
new_facts: RFK Jr.'s autism speech in Rochester, MN interrupted by duck-quacking phone; announced federal partnership for missing autistic people

stories.line: RFK Jr. continues promoting his health agenda while avoiding direct discussion of vaccines, his most controversial public health position.
